## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm lint` passes
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes
- [ ] `pnpm build` passes
- [ ] `pnpm-lock.yaml` is committed, if any `package.json` changed
- [ ] No component is imported across feature modules (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md#module-structure))
- [ ] Any new bundled asset (font, translation, image, media) has a row in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) naming its license
